newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - France - Le Monde Nov 29.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Government to try and solve the truckers conflict by resorting to a decree on payment of all work hours including waiting time linked to cargo loading and unloading. Decree may be signed this weekend.

-- Aerospatiale and Dassault chairmen have confirmed their merger should be effective within two years, adding the two companies would have been interested in Thomson, to achieve a vertical industrial integration of the defence industry. The government is proposing to sell Thomson to Lagardere.
-- CDR body in charge of selling off Credit Lyonnais assets plans divestment of a one-billion-franc property loans portfolio.
-- Credit Foncier de France to post up to one billion francs profit for 1996, according to union sources.
-- Franc reaches lowest level since mid-September, as debate on monetary policy worries operators.
-- Paris bourse draws close to all-time high.
